description: Talks on one day that assume a given concept, with all the concepts each one assumes. Use it to find talks that build on something the student knows. assumes_status is "tagged" when the talk's concepts are known; anything else means it isn't sorted yet, so never call it ready. A tagged talk that assumes no concepts is ready for everyone.

configuration.query: FROM sessions | WHERE is_talk == true AND DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", day) == ?day | EVAL needs = assumes, local = starts_at - 7 hours, time = DATE_FORMAT("EEE HH:mm", local) | MV_EXPAND assumes | WHERE assumes == TO_LOWER(REPLACE(?concept, " ", "-")) | SORT local | KEEP title, time, room, needs, assumes_status | LIMIT 100

day.description: The day as YYYY-MM-DD. KubeCon talks run 2026-11-09 (Mon) to 2026-11-12 (Thu).

concept.description: A concept slug such as networking-basics, or its name such as Networking basics (spaces become hyphens).
